subject: DeltaQ SIG / SOC2 evidence — artifact list & transfer cadence
messages:
From: Sam Barlow <sam@deltaq.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@deltaq.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DeltaQ RFI — initial evidence asks

Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — DeltaQ is moving our vendor short-list forward this month. Our security team has a few itemized evidence requests scoped to the SIG questionnaire (we've attached our latest RFI PDF). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following artifacts and an estimated delivery cadence?

- SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months (redacted OK)
- ISO 27001 scope and certificate (if in scope)
- Key management proof: KMS key rotation logs and key custody owner list
- Telemetry sample: anonymized service-level traces showing tokenization and telemetry sampling policy
- Network segmentation diagrams and firewall rule snapshots (last 90 days)
- Data retention and deletion policy, plus a representative audit log export

Also — preferred transfer method? DeltaQ security prefers SFTP or a pre-provisioned SharePoint folder with MFA link. If there are any export limitations (e.g., audit log retention window), please call them out.

We'd like a minimal artifact bundle by EOD next Tuesday (2026-06-23) to meet procurement timelines. If any item will take longer, please let us know which and why.

Thanks,
Sam Barlow
Head of Information Security
DeltaQ

Attachment: DeltaQ-RFI-v3.pdf (RFI + control mapping)
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Cc: procurement@deltaq.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DeltaQ RFI — initial evidence asks

Sam — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We can produce the majority of those artifacts; below is a short runbook for what we can deliver by your target and what will need an extra step.

Deliverable (by 2026-06-23):
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF) — available (we'll remove sensitive customer names).
- ISO 27001 certificate & scope statement — available if requested (Redwood currently maintains ISO for our control plane; will confirm scope).
- Data retention & deletion policy — available.
- Representative audit log export (last 30 days) — available as CSV.

Requires additional coordination (estimated 2–5 business days additional):
- KMS key rotation logs — can export rotation events but need to coordinate with infra for redaction and proof format (HSM-backed keys require custodian redaction).
- Telemetry sample traces — possible; need to anonymize and remove request/response payloads (we can provide sampling configuration + 48-hour sample).
- Network diagrams & firewall rule snapshots — will need networking team's confirmation and a short redaction pass.

Preferred transfer: Redwood can upload a secured artifact bundle to a pre-provisioned SFTP, or we can share via a time-limited Google Drive link with MFA. Please confirm which you prefer and provide an endpoint.

I've attached a preliminary control mapping (Redwood_control_mapping_v1.xlsx) that maps your SIG items to our controls and indicates artifact names. For the items requiring extra coordination I've flagged an internal owner — cc'd Kimberly to start the artifact pulls.

Next steps:
1) Confirm transfer endpoint (SFTP or Drive) and whether your team needs additional NDAs for sample logs.
2) Kimberly will own the coordination for KMS + telemetry + network artifacts.
3) We'll ship the initial bundle by 2026-06-23 and follow up with any supplemental exports.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
